# Browser frame byte budget for the browser-two-peers CI job: the host's broadcast frames over its first 200 ticks.
# full = bytes of the first state frame; delta_avg = mean bytes of the delta frames among those 200 ticks.
# Measured on five CI runs (full, delta_avg): 38984202426 (582, 168), 38984501399 (582, 168), 38984861301 (582, 168),
# 38985125826 (582, 168), 38985368020 (582, 168). The frame sizes were identical in every run.
# Each ceiling is about 4x the measured value (582 x 4 = 2328, 168 x 4 = 672). The job fails above either.
full_ceiling_bytes=2328
delta_avg_ceiling_bytes=672
